+
+      with_tempfile(String.new(data)) do |path|

+
+def with_tempfile(content : String | Bytes, &block : String -> Void)
+  File.tempfile do |file|
+    case content
+    when String
+      file.print(content)
+    when Bytes
+      file.write(content)
+    end
+    file.flush
+    yield file.path
+  end
+end
